name: DEVIL Taizou
source:
Member of the Maya Union. Holds the name "Steel Arm" aka. "Iron Man". He was a former assassination targer with a priority number of 70. 
Although he doesn't even resemble any kind of human, he's a fully pledged Japanese. He has a height of 3 meters and has these grotesquely large eyes.
One of his defining features is the spurt of blood everywhere on him, which he got from fighting with the other members.
